attempts.summary: Configured zram-backed compressed swap on node1 (Ubuntu 24.04) via systemd's native zram-generator: installed systemd-zram-generator and the missing linux-modules-extra-6.8.0-71-generic package (zram kernel module was absent from the base image), set /etc/systemd/zram-generator.conf to zram-size = max(ram/2, 512) with zstd compression and swap-priority 100, and activated it. Result is a ~983.5 MB zstd-compressed zram0 swap device, exceeding the 512 MB minimum, with no disk-backed swap present so it is trivially the preferred (and only) swap. Verified the configuration is boot-persistent by rebooting node1 and confirming the swap reappeared automatically with no manual step, plus confirmed a genuine restart via changed boot_id/uptime.
